fact: ANIP's procurement notice for software and IT accessories (tablet chargers, maintenance and network kits), following its procurement plan published on 5 March 2025, states that the agency obtained funds from the Budget National under its budget to finance its programme of administration and management of the Registre national des personnes physiques; no amount is given.
title: Acquisition de logiciels et accessoires informatiques (chargeurs tablette, valise de maintenance informatique, kit d'outils réseau informatique) au profit de l'ANIP
why_not: Parent, 2026-10-10: states the same fact as lead 3, ANIP's later notice (Budget National funds); one such document is enough.
